decision: Selected the applicant-declared site point on the planning application form for Redcar and Cleveland application R/2026/0337/FFM (Planning Portal PP-14889801) as the project locator for the proposed Sembcorp Wilton International Data Centre campus on the former Invista site. It is not a building footprint, the red-line boundary or a surveyed position.

selected_properties.form: Application for Planning Permission, Planning Portal reference PP-14889801, published (redacted) on the Redcar and Cleveland planning register for R/2026/0337/FFM, uploaded 8 May 2026
selected_properties.address: Land at Wilton International, Wilton International, Redcar, Middlesbrough TS6 8JH
selected_properties.description: Erection and use of a data centre campus (Use Class B8) comprising data centre buildings, communications and power buildings, security and support office buildings, backup generators, storage tanks and pump buildings, together with associated plant, infrastructure, access, parking, landscaping and ancillary works

transform.source_crs: EPSG:27700 (British National Grid; the form's Easting (x) / Northing (y) fields)

consistency_checks.planning_statement_grid_reference: The applicants' amended Planning Statement (V2, 1 September 2026; uploaded 7 September 2026) says the site is centred on NZ 562 209 (456200, 520900 at 100 m resolution), 114 m north-east of the form point, and that the red line extends to about 15.5 ha.
consistency_checks.location_plan: Drawing WDC-RO-ZZ-00-D1-A-1003 rev 2 (Phase 1 Location Plan, 1:2500) shows a 154,553 sq m red line west of the Wilton plant grid, bounded on the west by Kettle Beck and north of Greystone substation; it carries no coordinates, so it is used only for orientation.
consistency_checks.postcode_centroid: The ONS centroid of TS6 8JH (postcodes.io: 456088, 521246; 54.583326, -1.133708) lies 420 m north and is not used.
consistency_checks.imagery: Esri World Imagery z17 tiles (x 65122-65124, y 41722-41724) viewed locally and not redistributed: the point falls on cleared former industrial land with grass, scrub and remnant hard-standing and internal roads, west of the grid of cleared plant bases, consistent with the Planning Statement's description of the site.

uncertainty: The form publishes no positional accuracy; the 15.45 ha application site extends a few hundred metres around the point, and the data-centre buildings' positions relative to it are shown only on plans without coordinates.
